Team Name: Whispers from the Dust  

Looking for teammates!

Hi everyone!  

I’m building a storytelling project for the challenge Abandoned but not Forgotten: Storytelling about NASA’s Discarded Equipment on the Moon and Mars.

​About Me
I’m passionate about space history, science communication, and turning real NASA hardware into stories that young people can feel and remember. I already have a clear project vision: an interactive experience where the abandoned equipment on the Moon and Mars
